machine: Nexus pylon, 4 CPU, nothing else running
order: base first, then head, alternating, two runs a side, in separate worktrees set up with .nexus/resume --setup and npm run build before the first run
limit: fail when the head median is over 10% above base and outside base range

result.note: Head adds about 4 s of tests. Each side ran slower on its second run (base +28 s, head +30 s), and head always ran after base, so most of the gap is drift between runs, which is a reading and not a measure. The four review-fix commits after eb81db66 touch only the person-removal path and add three unit tests; they were not timed. The rebase onto 97fa2b60 made eb81db66 into 88aafc5b, and it conflicted only in deploy/README.md prose.
